Author: koko
Name: Raid Codex
Punchline: Record a fight, then make it a plan on Koko's Raid Codex.
Description:
Records the fights you're in: the boss's casts and where they land, stacks, spreads, tankbusters, tethers, head markers and waymarks, and (if you like) where your party stood. Every pull goes to your logs on Koko's Raid Codex as it ends (public there with your party's names, as on FFLogs; you can make yours private, or turn uploading off). Make a pull a plan, step by step, ready to draw your strats on, or save it as a file to import there.

In a duty you've made a plan for, a small window shows it step by step, moving along with the pull, with callouts in chat a few seconds before each mechanic.

It only watches: nothing is sent to the game. Open it with /raidcodex (/raidplan still works).
